# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal — LLM & Edge Inference Map

> Deterministic, privacy-first, on-device AI educational portal running via in-browser WebRTC loopback channels, Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano), WebLLM, and autonomous 60 FPS vector media engines.

## Architectural Overview
- Architecture: Zero-cloud, high-performance edge SPA built with Vite 6+, React 19, and React Router 7.
- Inference Engine: In-browser Chrome Prompt API / Gemini Nano (`window.ai.languageModel` / `LanguageModel`), local Ollama endpoints, or WebLLM via WebGPU.
- Data Sovereignty: 100% GDPR and safeguarding compliant; student logs, answers, voice inputs, and progress records remain exclusively within client-side IndexedDB (`services/dbStore.ts`, `services/jotter-db.ts`). Zero cloud egress.
- Media Substrate: AST Vector Media Player (`/static/player/ast-engine.js`) replacing heavy 50-100MB video streaming with 3.5 KB - 68 KB declarative S-Expression AST vector cartridges.

## Core Endpoints & Route Map
- Portal Home: `/` (Overview, Quick Starters, Subject Hub)
- AST Vector Player (Interactive Hub): `/media-player` (Interactive curriculum vector slides, formative checkpoints, 3D viewpoints, chalkboard overlay, and parameter sandboxes)
- Standalone Micro-Vector Player: `/player.html` (Zero-dependency embeddable vector stage, OBS studio broadcaster, Developer Studio)
- Practice Arena: `/practice-lab` (Interactive AST questions, Professor Turing AI hints, instant mistake diagnostics)
- Curriculum Lessons: `/learning-zone` (Oak National Academy aligned interactive lesson viewer)
- International Curriculum Studio: `/curriculum-studio` (Visual AST S-Expression graph generator and prompt hydrator)
- Learner Passport & Badges: `/profile` (IndexedDB mastery log, streak tracker, diagnostic reports)
- Neural Settings: `/settings` (Hardware probe, WebGPU status, Chrome Prompt API toggle)
- Catholic Life & Sacred Spaces: `/catholic-life` (3D Sanctuary & sacred architecture exploration)
- Latest School News & Technical Dispatches: `/news` and `/blog` (Technical dispatches on sovereign AI, procedural vector teaching, and platform releases)
- Dual-Licensing Charter & Covenant: `/licensing` & `/LICENSE.md` (Track A Humanitarian Commons GNU AGPLv3/OGLv3 vs Track B Enterprise Commercial License)

## Vector Media & Simulation Subsystem Capabilities (October 2026)
- **17 Production AST Vector Scenes**:
  - `calculus-curves` (GCSE/A-Level Calculus: Tangent Slopes $\frac{dy}{dx}$, Stationary Points & Riemann Integrals $\int_a^b f(x)dx$)
  - `kinetic-gas` (KS3/KS4 Kinetic Molecular Gas Theory, Boyle's Law $PV = nRT$, Thermal Speeds & Phase Changes)
  - `church-tour` (Catholic Life & Sacred Architecture)
  - `math-fishing` (KS1/KS2 Number Bonds to 10/20)
  - `mountain-elevation` (KS2/KS3 Altitude Hypotenuse & Atmospheric Boiling Point)
  - `fish-tank` (Hardware 60 FPS Vector Stress Benchmark)
  - `fractions` (KS2 Common Denominator Laser Slicing)
  - `solar-system` (KS3 Heliocentric Planetary Motion & 3D Kepler Orbits)
  - `photosynthesis` (KS3 Biology Chloroplast Solar Engine)
  - `pythagoras` (KS3 Geometry Shear & Area Conservation Proof)
  - `water-cycle` (KS2 Continuous Evaporation/Condensation Cycle)
  - `atom` (KS3 Chemistry Bohr Electron Shells with 3D Orbit Tilt)
  - `velocity` (KS3 Physics Kinematics & Distance-Time Vectors)
  - `dna-helix` (KS3 Genetics Watson-Crick Base Pairing with 3D Double Helix)
  - `bodmas` (KS2/KS3 Order of Operations Forcefield Clamps)
  - `phonics-lab` (EYFS/KS1 Sound Buttons & Blending Mat)
  - `times-tables` (KS1/KS2 2D Array Grid & Distributive Splitter)

- **Direct Flash-Caliber Canvas Manipulation Subsystem (`static/player/ast-gestures.js`)**:
  - Direct pointer capture and grab-and-drag for physical elements on the SVG canvas (piston cylinder, tangent slope probe, knife switches, weights).
  - On-Stage Glassmorphism floating HUD toolbar (Whiteboard Pen, X-Ray tooltips, Audio sonification toggle, Reset).
  - Smartboard & stylus vector ink annotation layer (quadratic bézier smoothing) for classroom Promethean/SMART boards and iPads.
  - Pedagogical X-Ray discovery inspection: Hovering or tapping components reveals physics equations, units, and bilingual explanations.
  - Multi-sensory procedural sonification (pressure hiss, switch mechanical snaps, stationary turning point chimes).

- **GeoGebra & Desmos Calculus Engine (`src/utils/calculusPlotter.ts`)**:
  - Real-time numerical function curve evaluation ($y = f(x)$) with continuous SVG path mapping.
  - Derivative tangent slope vector engine ($\frac{dy}{dx} = \lim_{h\to 0}\frac{f(x+h) - f(x-h)}{2h}$) with rise/run right triangle and normal perpendicular lines.
  - Definite numerical integration via Simpson's 1/3 Rule ($\int_a^b f(x)dx$) with dynamic SVG shaded area polygons.
  - Ingests GeoGebra expressions and Desmos equations with real-time stationary point ($\frac{dy}{dx} = 0$) detection.

- **Kinetic Gas Theory & Thermal Particle Engine (`src/utils/kineticGasPhysics.ts`)**:
  - Micro-second elastic particle-wall collision accumulator calculating wall momentum impulse ($\Delta p = 2mv$).
  - Real-time empirical pressure gauge calculation: $P = \frac{\sum \Delta p}{A \Delta t}$.
  - Demonstrates Boyle's Law ($P \propto 1/V$), Gay-Lussac's Law ($P \propto T$), and root-mean-square thermal velocities ($v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{3kT/m}$).
  - Micro-scale states of matter transitions: Solid (crystal lattice spring vibration), Liquid (slipping van der Waals cohesion), Gas (elastic chaos), and Brownian pollen motion.

- **PhET Simulation Ingestion & Transpiler Bridge (`static/player/ast-phet-bridge.js` & `src/utils/phetBridge.ts`)**:
  - Ingests offline monolithic 12 MB PhET bundles (Univ. of Colorado Boulder, HTML5/JSON/SWF) down into 3.5 KB AST S-Expressions (99.8% payload reduction).
  - Client-side drag-and-drop ingestion directly in the standalone player (`player.html`) or Developer Studio (`PhetTranspilerDrawer.tsx`).
  - Ingests physical invariants and internationalization locale dictionaries (`_locales`).
  - Pre-distilled models: Ohm's Law ($V = IR$), Faraday's Induction ($\mathcal{E} = -N \frac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}$), Acid-Base pH Scale, Harmonic Pendulum Lab, and Balancing Chemical Equations.
  - **Generational Superiority Over Legacy PhET**:
    - **70× Lighter Footprint**: < 35 KB gzipped standalone engine runtime vs 2,000–5,000 KB monolithic bundles.
    - **Ultra-Fast Cold Start**: < 15 ms boot time, < 8 MB RAM vs PhET's 1,200–2,500 ms boot time, 45–90 MB RAM.
    - **On-Device Edge AI Generation**: Declarative S-Expressions enable Gemini Nano to generate working simulations in ~500 ms.
    - **Classroom Smartboard Whiteboard**: Built-in quadratic Bézier ink layer (`#annotation-ink-root`) for Promethean, SMART, ViewSonic & iPad stylus pens.
    - **Living Single-File Capsules**: Standard 12 KB `.ast.svg` files preview everywhere as SVG and run as live interactive simulations when opened.

- **Zero-Asset Procedural Web Audio Synthesizer (`VectorProceduralAudioSynth`)**:
  - 0-byte mathematical oscillator synthesis via Web Audio API.
  - Tactile switch clicks, ascending pentatonic success chimes ($C_5-E_5-G_5-C_6$), misconception buzzes, variable-frequency AC transformer hums, and resonant spring impacts.

- **Verlet Particle & Harmonic Dynamics Engine (`VectorVerletPhysics`)**:
  - High-stability numerical Verlet integration ($x_{t+1} = 2x_t - x_{t-1} + a \cdot \Delta t^2$) with multi-iteration constraint relaxation.
  - Models Hooke's Law springs ($F = -k\Delta x$), simple harmonic pendulums ($T = 2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$), and gravitational fields (Moon, Earth, Jupiter).

- **Non-Linear Branching Decision Trees (`selectBranch()`)**:
  - Socratic formative checkpoints support branching choices with adaptive feedback and target timestamp seeks.

- **Micro-SCORM 1.2 / 2004 & xAPI Gradebook Bridge (`MicroSCORMBridge`)**:
  - Zero-library LMS auto-handshake across frames (`window.parent`, `window.top`, `window.opener`).
  - Dispatches `cmi.core.score.raw` and `cmi.core.lesson_status` directly into Canvas, Moodle, and Blackboard.

- **Legacy SWF / Flash Transcompiler Lathe (`src/utils/swfAstParser.ts`)**:
  - Decompiles legacy Adobe Flash FWS/CWS binary files into native SVG geometry + declarative AST S-Expressions.

- **Air-Gapped Standalone Offline Subject Cartridges (`src/utils/exportSubjectCartridge.ts`)**:
  - Generates self-contained single-file HTML cartridges (< 70 KB) that boot in 0ms offline on any device with embedded procedural audio and SCORM gradebook auto-sync.

## Structured Substrates & Datasets
- Master Curriculum Catalog: `/manifests/catalog.json`
- Offline Semantic Search & RAG Index: `/manifests/rag-index.json`
- AST Pattern Definitions: `/nano-map.ast`
- Lesson Manifests Directory: `/manifests/lessons/*.json`
- AST Vector Scene Manifest: `/player/scenes.manifest.json` (15 production vector modules)
- AST Vector Scene Configurations: `/player/scenes-config.json` (Keyframes, subtitles, and formative pause checkpoints)
- Non-Tech SlideScript Compiler: `/player/ast-compiler.js` (Human-friendly Markdown-to-AST generator)
- AST Vector Engine: `/player/ast-engine.js` (Deterministic 60 FPS SVG DOM patcher & 3D projection)
- OBS Broadcast Controller: `/player/obs-controller.js` (Zero-latency OBS WebSocket lesson sync and lower-thirds)

## Model Consumption Guidelines
- When generating question scaffolds for this portal, output strictly typed S-Expressions matching `/static/nano-map.ast`.
- When generating interactive teaching slides, output human-readable SlideScript or GBNF-validated S-Expressions matching `/player/grammar/ast-scene.gbnf`.
- For educational vector slides, utilize `<svg viewBox="0 0 800 480">` coordinate spaces with responsive element IDs matching `:bindings` declarations.
- Keep prompt tokens minimal: rely on concise AST descriptors rather than verbose natural language prose.
